heroTitle: PonyLife is a coordination platform for intangible creative assets, designed to enable shared experimentation with visibility, liquidity, and economic outcomes through delegated rights and collective participation mechanisms.
heroSubtitle: We study how shared participation can redistribute attention and uncertainty without financial promises, guarantees, or optimization for “hits”.

cards.title: Works enter a shared ecosystem
cards.text: Creative works are associated with PonyLife to exist within a common visibility layer rather than in isolation.

cards.title: Participation replaces prediction
cards.text: Participants coordinate attention and effort without knowing outcomes in advance.

cards.title: Outcomes remain independent
cards.text: Each work succeeds or fails on its own terms. PonyLife does not pool or guarantee results.

cards.title: PNL enables coordination
cards.text: A token is used only as a mechanism for participation and alignment — not as an investment product.

featured.title: Featured Works
featured.subtitle: A small selection from the public catalog. Inclusion does not imply endorsement, valuation, or expected outcomes.
